triples.evidence_text: Piping having passed the fire endurance test specified in 4-6-3/13 hereunder for a duration of a minimum of one hour without loss of integrity in the dry condition is considered to meet the Level 1 fire endurance standard (L1).

triples.head_surface: Piping systems similar to Level 1 systems except these systems do not carry flammable fluid or any gas and a maximum 5% flow loss in the system after exposure is acceptable
triples.evidence_text: Level 1W – Piping systems similar to Level 1 systems except these systems do not carry flammable fluid or any gas and a maximum 5% flow loss in the system after exposure is acceptable.

Piping having passed the fire endurance test specified in 4-6-3/13 hereunder for a duration of a minimum of 30 minutes without loss of integrity in the dry condition is considered to meet the Level 2 fire endurance standard (L2).

triples.head_surface: Piping systems similar to Level 2 systems except a maximum 5% flow loss in the system after exposure is acceptable
triples.evidence_text: Level 2W – Piping systems similar to Level 2 systems except a maximum 5% flow loss in the system after exposure is acceptable.

Piping having passed the fire endurance test specified in 4-6-3/15 hereunder for a duration of a minimum of 30 minutes without loss of integrity in the wet condition is considered to meet the Level 3 fire endurance standard (L3).

triples.head_surface: fire protective coating of pipes and fittings
triples.tail_surface: Random samples of pipe are to be tested to determine the adhesion qualities of the coating to the pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 随机抽样测试涂层附着力
triples.evidence_text: Random samples of pipe are to be tested to determine the adhesion qualities of the coating to the pipe.

triples.tail_surface: delivered from the manufacturer with the protective coating applied, with on-site application limited to that necessary for installation purposes (i.e., joints)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 厂家预涂防火层且现场仅限接头补涂
triples.evidence_text: Pipes are generally to be delivered from the manufacturer with the protective coating applied, with on-site application limited to that necessary for installation purposes (i.e., joints).

triples.tail_surface: The test procedures in 4-6-3/17 in accordance with IMO Resolution A.753(18) Guidelines for the application of plastic pipes on ships, as amended by Resolution MSC.399(95), are to be used for determining the flame spread characteristics
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按IMO A.753(18)及MSC.399(95)修正案的火焰蔓延特性测试程序
triples.evidence_text: The test procedures in 4-6-3/17 in accordance with IMO Resolution A.753(18) Guidelines for the application of plastic pipes on ships, as amended by Resolution MSC.399(95), are to be used for determining the flame spread characteristics.
